rows.summary: Markdown and the ATS text follow Section Options as the PDF and Word do: Show dates off prints no date on any dated section (experience, education, volunteering, projects, a certificate's date and expiry, awards, custom), Show location off no location on experience, education and volunteering (a custom entry's location prints whatever the options, as in the PDF), and an experience section's Order puts the company or the role first — unset, the résumé template's default through resolveSection. The ATS text prints every date in Design → Date format (formatDate) and a current job's end as presentLabel. Fail-first: 7 of 10 tests failed before 4a6f968; the template-Order tests failed before 54f270f.
Duplicate of R2-064 (Markdown and ATS text ignored Show dates / Show location); fixed there.
Duplicate of R2-064 (ATS text ignored Date format, Show dates and Show location); fixed there.
Duplicate of R2-064, Order included: an experience section's Order (Co. / Role, Role / Co., or the template's default when unset) now applies in Markdown and the ATS text.
Duplicate of R2-064: the ATS text prints every date in Design → Date format and 'Present' through presentLabel.

The Markdown contact line is built from contactItems/contactHref, the PDF's contact lines: a website, LinkedIn or GitHub prints its Display label (else its address without the scheme) and links through safeHref, so a javascript: Link URL is no link and a bare-domain one links https://. The 'Email:'/'Phone:'/'Location:' prefixes are gone and a phone links tel:, as in the PDF. Fail-first: 3 of 4 tests failed before the fix.

On the Cover Letter tab the Export menu says what each item exports: 'Export Cover Letter PDF / Word', and 'Export Résumé as Markdown (.md) / ATS Text (.txt) / JSON Resume (.json)' (useEditorExports returns letterTab; EditorHeader passes it). The résumé tab's menu is unchanged. Fail-first: 3 of 4 tests failed before the fix.
rows.remaining: The letter has no plain-text export of its own (the row allowed the smaller honest fix).

notes: Changed existing assertions (the rows ask for it): role-first pins in tests/unit/ats-plain-text.unit.mjs, markdown-export-sections.unit.mjs, markdown-export.unit.mjs and tests/pdf/70-markdown-parity.test.mjs now expect Classic's company-first default; tests/unit/json-resume-hidden.unit.mjs and json-resume-reprint.unit.mjs give the original résumé settings.dateFormat 'MMM YYYY' because they compare ATS text across the JSON Resume trip, and the import gives a résumé the Classic starter's Date format.
